text.id: ...Lo dapet dari mana semua itu? Pak Hendra? Tasya?
text.en: ...Where did you get all that? Pak Hendra? Tasya?

text.id: Dari mana-mana. Kayak lo naro remah roti sepanjang setahun.
text.en: From everywhere. Like you left breadcrumbs for a whole year.

text.id: Dia diem lama. Terus dia nyalain alat rekamnya, scroll ke folder yang namanya cuma "KA". Dua belas file. Satu tiap bulan. Yang pertama, "0612".
text.en: She's quiet for a long time. Then she switches on the recorder and scrolls to a folder named just "KA". Twelve files. One a month. The first one is "0612".

text.id: Episode nol. Gue bikin setahun ini. Buat lo. Nggak bakal pernah tayang. Isinya semua hal yang nggak bisa gue omongin di depan lo.
text.en: Episode zero. I made it over this year. For you. It was never going to air. It's everything I couldn't say to your face.

text.id: Halo, pendengar. Pendengarnya satu. Namanya Raka, dan dia nggak tahu acara ini ada.
text.en: Hi, listener. There's one listener. His name is Raka, and he doesn't know this show exists.

text.id: Segmen dua belas. Ka, gue takut. Tapi tiap gue takut, gue ngebayangin lo di ruang edit, ngedumel soal angin. Dan gue jadi nggak terlalu takut.
text.en: Segment twelve. Ka, I'm scared. But every time I'm scared, I picture you in the edit room, grumbling about the wind. And I'm not so scared anymore.

text.id: Kalau suatu hari lo denger ini, segmen terakhirnya punya lo. Gue tinggalin kosong.
text.en: If you ever hear this, the last segment is yours. I've left it empty.

text.id: Satu headphone, dua kuping. Lampu merah kecil di alat rekamnya nyala.
text.en: One pair of headphones, two ears. The little red light on the recorder comes on.

text.id: Segmen tiga belas. Ini Raka. Gue telat setahun.{w} Dan gue nggak bakal ke mana-mana lagi.
text.en: Segment thirteen. This is Raka. I'm a year late.{w} And I'm not going anywhere again.

text.id: Itu intro terjelek yang pernah gue denger.
text.en: That's the worst intro I've ever heard.

text.id: Potong aja. Lo kan udah bisa ngedit sendiri.
text.en: Cut it, then. You can edit by yourself now.

text.id: Nggak. Yang ini nggak gue potong.
Kita ngerekam sampai lampu di tiang mati sendiri. Soal Didit, soal polisi, soal kapal yang dateng besok pagi. Itu episode lain.
text.en: We record until the lamp on the post goes out by itself. About Didit, about the police, about the boats coming in the morning. That's another episode.
This one is off the record.

summary.id: Raka mendengar semua voice note yang tak pernah terkirim, dan Sekar memutarkan Episode 0 untuknya. Segmen terakhirnya mereka rekam berdua.
summary.en: Raka heard every voice note that was never sent, and Sekar played him Episode 0. They recorded its last segment together.
